description.text: The predecessors of Three Gorges University, Gezhouba Hydropower Engineering College (1978) and Wuhan University of Water Conservancy and Electric Power (Yichang), were successively subordinate to the Ministry of Water Resources and Electric Power, the Ministry of Energy and the Ministry of Electric Power Industry, and entered the ranks of universities under the "211" Plan, and are first-class universities in China. Electrical engineering is a "domestic first-class discipline construction discipline", and in 1998, it was approved as a national "211" engineering construction discipline, which is a key discipline (feature) in Hubei Province; It has a first-level doctoral program in electrical engineering and a postdoctoral research mobile station. There are 76 teaching and research personnel in this first-level discipline, including 27 professors and 37 associate professors; There are 63 doctoral degree personnel, 15 doctoral supervisors and 58 master supervisors. It has 12 provincial and ministerial key laboratories (centers), including the National Electrical Engineering Virtual Simulation Experimental Teaching Center, the National Experimental Teaching Center for Transmission Line Engineering, the National and Local Joint Engineering Research Center for New Graphite Materials, the Hubei Provincial Key Laboratory of Cascade Hydropower Station Operation and Control, and the Hubei Collaborative Innovation Center of New Energy Microgrid. In the past five years, 698 master's degree students and 2,746 bachelor's degree undergraduates have been awarded. The faculty members have published more than 700 academic papers in related fields, including more than 360 high-quality papers in three categories, 16 highly cited papers, and 16 textbooks and monographs. Undertake more than 500 scientific research projects, with project funds of more than 80 million yuan, including 32 national projects; Won 15 provincial and ministerial level and above science and technology awards, including 3 provincial first prizes and above; 225 national invention patents have been authorized, and more than 30 patents have been transformed.

duration.text: The Electrical Engineering at China Three Gorges University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Scanned copy of valid ordinary passport (personal information page). 2. Notarized highest diploma or degree certificate issued directly by university with official stamp and signature; Documents in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations. 3. Academic transcripts of the highest diploma (Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations.); 4. A Study Plan or Research Proposal (written in Chinese or English); 5. Two Recommendation Letters signed by professors or associate professors for postgraduate programs applicants. (written in Chinese or English); 6. A 3-5 minutes video clip to introduce yourself in English or Chinese. (Please send the video named by the passport number and your full name to our official email) 7. Non-Criminal Record Certificate. 8. Foreigner Physical Examination Form valid within 6 months (photocopy). 9. The copy of valid HSK Certificate or English level certificate if have; 10. Financial Support Statement should be provided by the Local Government Scholarship Applicants & Self-support applicants 11. Other documents (Title Lists of Published Papers or Introductions of Research programs)

requirements.text: 1. Foreign citizenship with valid passport. Note: The applicants should hold the valid foreign passport or nationality certificate more than 4 years. In the latest 4 years (up to April 30 of the enrollment year), the applicants lived in a foreign country more than 2 years (the actual living abroad for more than 9 months in a year can be counted as one year, subject to the entry and exit stamps). 2. Chinese Friendly; good physical and mental health; hardworking; academically excellent. 3. The requirements for applicants’ degree and age are that applicants must: （1）be a holder of high school diploma or its equivalent under the age of 25 when applying for an undergraduate program; （2）be a holder of a Bachelor’s degree or its equivalent under the age of 35 when applying for a Master’s program; （3）be a holder of a Master’s degree or its equivalent under the age of 40 when applying for a doctoral program;
